summary: Candidate is a distinct micro_skill for Spring Boot 3.0 Hibernate migration (dependency group ID update + deprecated property removal). It does not semantically match any existing skill in the registry (which cover Next.js prefetching, Flink test data injection, and unrelated domains). Peer candidates are sibling Spring Boot 3.0 migration skills (MySQL driver, Redis config, Ehcache) but represent separate, non-overlapping upgrade tasks. Candidate has valid support evidence from Spring Boot 3.0 Migration Guide and no conflicts.
